policy: Files listed under `assets` may not be modified, replaced, deleted, or have new sibling variants added without (a) Shamil's explicit chat approval naming the file, AND (b) updating the matching `sha256` here in the SAME commit, AND (c) the commit message containing the token `ASSET-LOCK-OVERRIDE: <reason>`. The pre-commit hook at `.husky/pre-commit` runs `scripts/asset-lock-check.mjs` to enforce this.

rules: No agent may iterate locked assets autonomously to chase a 'better' look. Any swap requires Shamil saying the new design is better in chat, with the new file/hash recorded here in the same commit.
No more than one approved swap per 24 hours unless Shamil explicitly authorizes a second.
